name: Sakura Yukari
source:
The protagonist's uncle's wife. That is, Kyouko's aunt by marriage. A shrewd woman who runs the Sakura family, landowners in Setagaya. 

The reason the freeter protagonist can live in a fairly stylish apartment is because she's the building's owner.

She seems to have a long-standing feud with Yoyogi Kamo, the headmaster of Yoyogi Married Women's Academy.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
